map.由支出分项求 GDP: Finding GDP from its expenditure components
map.输入消费 C、投资 I、政府支出 G、净出口 NX，求 GDP。: Enter consumption C, investment I, government spending G and net exports NX to get GDP.
map.📖 查看「由支出分项求 GDP 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding GDP from Its Expenditure Components Usage Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：由支出分项求 GDP: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding GDP from Its Expenditure Components
map.总量核算：录入四项，算 GDP 总量。: Aggregate accounting: enter the four components to compute total GDP.
map.结构分析：看各项占比，判断需求驱动结构。: Structural analysis: look at each share to judge what drives demand.
map.教学演示：演示净出口为负（逆差）拉低 GDP。: Teaching demo: show how negative net exports (a deficit) drag GDP down.
map.示例：C=60、I=20、G=18、NX=2（万亿），GDP=100 万亿。: Example: C = 60, I = 20, G = 18, NX = 2 (trillion) gives GDP = 100 trillion.
map.C 消费、I 投资、G 政府购买、NX 净出口(出口−进口)，支出法口径。结果仅: C is consumption, I investment, G government purchases and NX net exports (exports − imports), the expenditure-approach definition.
